messages:
maria: opened PR to fix /v1/ingest example — request body in docs incorrectly shows an array of file ids; also Node snippet uses `files` param which no longer exists. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

maria: current wrong example:
```json
POST /v1/ingest
{
  "files": ["s3://bucket/1.pdf", "s3://bucket/2.pdf"],
  "metadata": {"batch": true}
}
```

maria: proposed correct example:
```json
POST /v1/ingest
{
  "file_uploads": [
    {"uri":"s3://bucket/1.pdf", "mime":"application/pdf"},
    {"uri":"s3://bucket/2.pdf", "mime":"application/pdf"}
  ],
  "metadata": {"batch": true}
}
```

raj: looks right. Need to update the Python/Go snippets too, and note the response schema changed (now returns `ingest_id` and `items_count` instead of array). :eyes:

toni: I'll update the JS/Node SDK snippet in the PR. Quick question: is the server still accepting `files` as alias? if not, we should add a migration note.

maria: server no longer accepts `files` alias — we removed it in api v2025-11. Added migration note in PR body but not in the example blocks. Can you add a short migration callout above examples? e.g., "If upgrading from <v2025-11>, replace `files` with `file_uploads`."

toni: ack. I'll push a small commit with updated Node snippet:
```js
// before
client.ingest({ files: ['s3://.../1.pdf'] })
// after
client.ingest({ file_uploads: [{ uri: 's3://.../1.pdf', mime: 'application/pdf' }] })
```

lee: CI failing on the docs-samples test: sample-validators flagged response shape mismatch. The tests expect top-level array. I pushed a test fix to the branch but want to confirm response example to include:
```json
{
  "ingest_id": "ing_123",
  "items_count": 2,
  "status": "queued"
}
```

maria: good catch — updated the response example in the PR to match. Also added line to changelog.

docs-bot: docs deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/ingest

sam: can we merge this today? It touches examples that E2E uses. If merging, schedule a hotfix on prod if anything breaks.

raj: let's wait for Toni's SDK snippet commit + one more review. @toni please tag me when done.

toni: pushed commit updating Node and adding migration note. PR now has ✅ local linter and sample tests fixed.

maria: thanks — nominated @raj and @lee for review, please LGTM when you can. I'll hold merge until 11:30 PT to monitor.

lee: quick nit: reword the migration intro to call out API version header `X-API-Version: 2025-11` — I'll add that as a suggestion in the PR.

raj: LGTM after the nit. merging after 11:30 PT. :thumbsup:

maria: merging now. will monitor errors/alerts.

docs-bot: merged PR #1234 by maria — preview link updated to prod docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/ingest

maria: post-merge: updating internal release notes and notifying integrators slack. tagging release-ops.
